relevance_rank_note: bioRxiv preprint (not peer reviewed, not indexed in PubMed) on lipidated ApoE2/E3/E4 particles in rat astrocytes; measures ApoE particle uptake (an LDLR-dependent ligand-uptake surrogate) and endolysosomal function, never receptor surface level or recycling, so findings are class 3-4 surrogates.

description: Rat primary astrocytes given lipidated human ApoE3 or ApoE4 particles for 15 min, then acid-washed to strip surface-bound ApoE, internalized the same amount of ApoE (western blot); the authors report no isoform difference. The panel is marked "ns" with no numeric P.
quote: We found that astrocytes internalized equivalent amounts of ApoE particles after 15 and 30 min of treatment, regardless of the isoform (Figures 2B-2D).
summary: (ApoE3 particles -> ApoE4 particles) -> (no change in ApoE particle internalization at 15 min, a surrogate for LDLR-family receptor available at the surface)
system: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from P0-P1 wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats (rat ApoE3 background), DIV 6-9; 25 ug/ml POPC particles with recombinant human ApoE2/E3/E4 (Expi293) in HBSS for 0/15/30 min; acid wash, western blot of intracellular hApoE normalized to beta-actin and to 0 min. Rodent neonatal astrocytes in vitro with exogenous lipidated ApoE.
human_check: Preprint, not peer reviewed. Figure viewed in browser (bioRxiv F3.large.jpg = Figure 2): panel 2C is marked 'ns' over E2/E3/E4, no numeric P; E3 and E4 means both ~2.5-fold over 0 min. The authors caution the assay may not detect subtle uptake differences. Discussion also cites a prior report (their ref 14) that ApoE4 is internalized LESS via LDLR, which this assay did not reproduce.

description: In the same uptake assay after 30 min of particle treatment, astrocytes again internalized similar amounts of ApoE4 and ApoE3; the ApoE4 mean was slightly lower but the panel is marked not significant. The panel is marked "ns" with no numeric P.
quote: We found that astrocytes internalized equivalent amounts of ApoE particles after 15 and 30 min of treatment, regardless of the isoform (Figures 2B-2D).
summary: (ApoE3 particles -> ApoE4 particles) -> (no significant change in ApoE particle internalization at 30 min)
system: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from P0-P1 wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats, DIV 6-9; 25 ug/ml POPC particles with recombinant human ApoE3 or ApoE4 in HBSS for 30 min; acid wash, western blot of intracellular hApoE normalized to beta-actin and to 0 min. Rodent neonatal astrocytes in vitro with exogenous lipidated ApoE.
human_check: Preprint. ~17% = E4 mean (~2.5) lower than E3 mean (~3.0) read off the plot; one of four E4 replicates sits near 1.0, so the spread is wide. Panel marked 'ns', no numeric P.

description: Rat primary astrocytes treated with lipidated ApoE4 particles had lower endolysosomal cathepsin D activity than astrocytes treated with ApoE3 particles, alongside fewer LysoTracker-positive acidic compartments.
quote: Indeed, astrocytes treated with ApoE4 particles had decreased activity of the endolysosomal protease cathepsin D (Figure 3C).
summary: (ApoE3 particles -> ApoE4 particles) -> (lower endolysosomal cathepsin D activity) -> (endolysosomal dysfunction, a possible upstream condition for impaired receptor sorting; receptors not measured)
system: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from P0-P1 wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats, DIV 6-9; 50 ug/ml POPC particles with recombinant human ApoE2/E3/E4 in HBSS (4 h); cathepsin D activity assay normalized to untreated cells. Rodent neonatal astrocytes in vitro with exogenous lipidated ApoE.
human_check: Preprint. Figure viewed in browser (bioRxiv F4.large.jpg = Figure 3): '**' bracket directly joins E3 and E4 in 3C; E3 ~1.0, E4 ~0.73 of untreated. By contrast, in 3B (LysoTracker puncta) the ** brackets join E4 to untreated and E4 to E2 only, with no E3-vs-E4 bracket, so the acidic-compartment decrease is not shown to be significant against ApoE3; 3B was therefore not entered as a row.
